name: Xrobb l-Għaġin
description: Easy shore dive on the east coast of Malta. Boulders and a weedy slope down to about 10–12 m, a reef with a sharp drop on the north-east side and a small islet in 3–6 m of water nearby. Not spectacular, but a relaxed dive with an easy entry.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
